ART: exceptionally crisp expressive manga-like faces, sharp eyes, bold variable-width Chinese calligraphic contour, large sculpted pools of black ink, dry-brush broken edges, fine off-white steel highlights. Reading order left to right, top to bottom:
1. poised low ready stance: left foot forward, blade in right hand lowered diagonally toward right, cloak blowing left.
2. anticipation: deeply bent knees, body coiled, sword drawn back over left shoulder, blade angled up-left, torso still faces right.
3. explosive low forward dash toward right: chest almost horizontal, right foot extended, left leg pushes, sword trailing behind to left, cloth streaming left.
4. rising sword strike: deep broad lunge toward right, right sword arm extended diagonally UP-RIGHT, jian tip high-right, bent leading knee, forceful torso twist.
5. high braced parry: body compressed slightly back, sword held diagonally UP-RIGHT in front of face, left hand supporting hilt wrist, both feet firmly spread.
6. fast straight thrust toward right: right arm fully extends, straight sword perfectly horizontal to right, lower long stance and hair streaming left.
7. overhead coiled attack: torso winds back, sword raised over head with tip up-left, cloth curled behind, low deep knees.
8. decisive descending slash follow-through: deep forward lunge, right sword hand near right hip, blade pointing diagonally DOWN-RIGHT, loose sleeve and long ribbons whip in a strong arc, face looks along blade.
9. controlled recovery: upright three-quarter back stance facing right, blade lowered to right, left hand near chest, hair and cloth settle into a flowing elegant silhouette.

Only original drawn fighter pixels on real transparent alpha. No checkerboard drawn into image. Avoid crossing cell borders, cropped blade tips, tiny characters, repeated poses, extra hands, duplicate weapons.
